name: When should I call a professional plumber for hard water stain issues?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional plumber for hard water stain issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider calling a professional plumber if hard water stains are extensive, recurring quickly after cleaning, or impacting the performance of your fixtures, such as reduced water flow or clogged showerheads. A plumber can assess the severity, recommend long-term solutions like water softeners, and professionally clean or repair fixtures that have been damaged by mineral buildup, especially in complex areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber for extensive, recurring hard water stains or if they are affecting fixture performance. A professional can assess the issue and recommend solutions.
